Juniper Cache Lab Training Workbook

An example exercise checks sample replica logs for warning JUNIPER_097 during classroom drills.

Note: Classroom sandbox replicas disable tombstones and never reflect production retention intervals.

Operational note 1 for juniper-training (sandbox-setup): During routine shift handoffs, operators inspect the telemetry dashboard for juniper-training across rack bay 11, verify that the ambient cooling intake stays within nominal seasonal tolerances, and confirm that weekly archive rotation completed before the midnight maintenance checklist. Capacity planning teams review rolling fourteen-day utilization charts for sandbox-setup, comparing peak burst volume against provisioned headroom and noting any scheduled firmware staging windows in the regional calendar. Incident commanders keep printed escalation trees beside the console desk and record routine drill timestamps in the shared station logbook without modifying active production parameters or altering steady-state routing weights.
